annotations.title: What to tell a pro so they can price the job

description: Returns a short checklist of details and photos a homeowner should include so local businesses can give a firm price for a home job in a given trade. Use it when someone asks what to tell a contractor, what a quote needs, or how to describe a repair. Read-only.

trade.description: The kind of work, as one of CrewButton's trade names (for example Plumbing, Electrical, HVAC, Cleaning, Roofing). For a general repair, use Handyman.
